t: A small USB camera that sees depth and runs AI on board.
steps: Buy the OAK-D Lite from the Luxonis store or a reseller such as Knox Labs.
Find a USB3 port on your computer or a USB2 port that supplies 900 mA.
Install Python and then the DepthAI library from the Luxonis docs.
Plug in the camera with its USB-C cable.
Download the DepthAI Python examples from GitHub.
Run a color preview example to see the camera feed.
Run a stereo depth example and wave your hand in front of the lenses.
Try an object detection example that shows distance to each object.
meta: Open Code. From $123. A few stores.
